Review outputs for safety when using that guidance.

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it's an instruction-only collection of prompt frameworks and examples, requests no credentials, and has no install steps. Before using: (1) remember it can encourage prompts that try to avoid model refusals—carefully review outputs on sensitive topics; (2) never paste secrets or private data into prompts; (3) test the recommended frameworks with non-sensitive examples to confirm they behave as you expect. Overall, it is appropriate to install/use, but always validate outputs before acting on them.
